.PROGRAM paletyzacja()
  SPEED 100 ALWAYS
  ACCEL 100 ALWAYS
  DECEL 100 ALWAYS
  .wyswarstwy = 100
  .ilewarstw = 7
; WARSTWA A
  POINT wa_cel[1] = poczatekpal+TRANS(300.000,600.000,-100.000,0,0,0)
  POINT wa_cel[2] = poczatekpal+TRANS(900.000,600.000,-100.000,0,0,0)
  POINT wa_cel[3] = poczatekpal+TRANS(300.000,200.000,-100.000,0,0,0)
  POINT wa_cel[4] = poczatekpal+TRANS(900.000,200.000,-100.000,0,0,0)
; WARSTWA B
  POINT wb_cel[1] = poczatekpal+TRANS(900.000,200.000,-100.000,180,0,0)
  POINT wb_cel[2] = poczatekpal+TRANS(300.000,200.000,-100.000,180,0,0)
  POINT wb_cel[3] = poczatekpal+TRANS(900.000,600.000,-100.000,180,0,0)
  POINT wb_cel[4] = poczatekpal+TRANS(300.000,600.000,-100.000,180,0,0)
  FOR .j = 1 TO .ilewarstw
    .z_offset = (.j-1)*.wyswarstwy
    .z_safe = 500+.z_offset
    IF (.j MOD 2)==1 THEN
      POINT cel[1] = wa_cel[1]
      POINT cel[2] = wa_cel[2]
      POINT cel[3] = wa_cel[3]
      POINT cel[4] = wa_cel[4]
    ELSE
      POINT cel[1] = wb_cel[1]
      POINT cel[2] = wb_cel[2]
      POINT cel[3] = wb_cel[3]
      POINT cel[4] = wb_cel[4]
    END
; CYKL 1
    JMOVE pobierz_najazd
    LMOVE pobierz
    SIGNAL 12,-13
    TWAIT 0.5
    LMOVE pobierz_najazd
    JMOVE SHIFT(cel[1] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[1] BY 0,0,.z_offset)
    SIGNAL -12,13
    TWAIT 0.2
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[1] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
; CYKL 2
    JMOVE pobierz_najazd
    LMOVE pobierz
    SIGNAL 12,-13
    TWAIT 0.5
    LMOVE pobierz_najazd
    JMOVE SHIFT(cel[2] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[2] BY 0,0,.z_offset)
    SIGNAL -12,13
    TWAIT 0.2
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[2] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
; CYKL 3
    JMOVE pobierz_najazd
    LMOVE pobierz
    SIGNAL 12,-13
    TWAIT 0.5
    LMOVE pobierz_najazd
    JMOVE SHIFT(cel[3] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[3] BY 0,0,.z_offset)
    SIGNAL -12,13
    TWAIT 0.2
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[3] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
; CYKL 4
    JMOVE pobierz_najazd
    LMOVE pobierz
    SIGNAL 12,-13
    TWAIT 0.5
    LMOVE pobierz_najazd
    JMOVE SHIFT(cel[4] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[4] BY 0,0,.z_offset)
    SIGNAL -12,13
    TWAIT 0.2
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[4] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
  END
.END
